description: Client/server SPA route parity. exact_routes and workspaces must equal the client's EXACT_ROUTES/WORKSPACES (frontend/src/lib/routes.ts) and the server's _SPA_EXACT_ROUTES/_WORKSPACES (server/app.py). client_routes must be accepted by parseRoute and served index.html; not_client_routes rejected by both. Checked by frontend/tests/unit/routes.test.ts and tests/unit/test_shell_route_support.py.
